item.name: FR-14 — Category management (CRUD)
item.description: Data-driven Category CRUD suite C1-001 to C1-040. It logs in using the seeded admin/user accounts and creates disposable categories where a case needs a target ID.

exec: const row = pm.iterationData; const baseUrl = pm.environment.get('baseUrl') || 'http://localhost:3000'; const authMode = row.get('authMode') || 'admin'; const setup = row.get('setup') || 'none'; const unique = `HW06-23127172-${row.get('id')}-${Date.now()}`; const adminEmail = pm.environment.get('adminEmail'); const adminPassword = pm.environment.get('adminPassword'); const testUserEmail = pm.environment.get('testUserEmail'); const testUserPassword = pm.environment.get('testUserPassword');

pm.request.method = row.get('method'); pm.request.url = baseUrl + row.get('path'); pm.request.body.update(row.get('rawBody') || ''); pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Content-Type', value: row.get('contentType') || 'application/json' });

const login = (email, password, done) => pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/api/login`, method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email, password }) } }, (err, res) => { if (err) throw err; const body = res.json(); if (!body.token) throw new Error(`FR-14 setup login failed (HTTP ${res.code})`); done(body.token); });

const create = (token, suffix, done) => pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/api/categories`, method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ name: `${unique}-${suffix}` }) } }, (err, res) => { if (err) throw err; const body = res.json(); if (!body.id) throw new Error(`FR-14 setup create failed (HTTP ${res.code})`); done(body.id); });
const applyAuth = token => pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Authorization', value: `Bearer ${token}` });

const prepareTarget = (adminToken, done) => { if (setup === 'none') return done(); if (setup === 'target') return create(adminToken, 'target', id => { pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14TargetId', id); done(); }); if (setup === 'two-targets') return create(adminToken, 'A', first => create(adminToken, 'B', second => { pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14TargetId', first); pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14SecondId', second); done(); })); if (setup === 'stale-target') return create(adminToken, 'A', first => pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/api/categories/${first}`, method: 'DELETE', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${adminToken}` } }, () => create(adminToken, 'B', second => { pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14TargetId', first); pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14SecondId', second); done(); }))); if (setup === 'referenced-target') return create(adminToken, 'referenced', id => pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/api/products`, method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ name: `${unique}-product`, price: 1, description: 'FR-14 referential test', imageUrl: '', category_id: id }) } }, () => { pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14TargetId', id); done(); })); done(); };

if (authMode === 'none') { if (setup === 'target') login(adminEmail, adminPassword, token => prepareTarget(token, () => pm.request.headers.remove('Authorization'))); else pm.request.headers.remove('Authorization'); } else if (authMode === 'invalid') { pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer invalid.token.value' }); } else if (authMode === 'user') { if (setup === 'target') login(adminEmail, adminPassword, adminToken => prepareTarget(adminToken, () => login(testUserEmail, testUserPassword, applyAuth))); else login(testUserEmail, testUserPassword, applyAuth); } else { login(adminEmail, adminPassword, token => { pm.collectionVariables.set('fr14Token', token); applyAuth(token); prepareTarget(token, () => {}); }); }
